entries.zh: 搅混、纠缠不清；疑兼市井戏谑、浑话打诨义（词头非通行词形，释义存疑）
entries.en: to mix and knead together, to tangle; prob. vulgar banter or mocking chatter (headword doubtful)
entries.notes: Burbelo 非标准 17 世纪西语通行词形，疑为 bureo/burla 类手稿变体；汉字栏有 糅/糾 异文，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 轻贱、作践；看轻贬弄
entries.en: to treat with contempt, make light of; to slight and mock

entries.zh: 轻贱糟践、以言语作弄（賤滚，滚字用法存疑）
entries.en: to slight and abuse with words; to make game of someone

entries.zh: 翻滚耍闹、滚闹作耍（音栏三音节对汉字仅一字，释义存疑）
entries.en: to tumble and romp in mocking play; sense uncertain
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅'滚'一字而音栏三音节（中音节未明），与第 17 条'合滚'或同类叠语，语义依赖推断。

entries.zh: 以言调笑、谑笑打闹（滚笑）
entries.en: to jest and banter with words; to mock in play

entries.zh: 戏弄、作弄；摆弄
entries.en: to tease, toy with; to make game of

entries.zh: 作弄、整蛊（闽南'創治'之創）；搅弄、搞出事端
entries.en: to play tricks on, torment teasingly; to stir up, create (mischief)

entries.zh: 嬉戏、动手逗弄（对恋人动手动脚地调笑）
entries.en: to frolic, tease with the hands; to flirt with and make sport of lovers

entries.zh: 戏耍、玩弄；嘲弄
entries.en: to mock, ridicule; to tease and make sport of
entries.notes: M 栏末混入西语原词 mofar（'hŷ zoà mofar'），系抄手将词头误入音栏，不影响释义。

entries.zh: 戏谑、打诨；嘲弄
entries.en: to banter and jest; to mock, ridicule

entries.zh: 戏弄恋人、轻薄逗弄（姦字疑为'姣'，带狎昵义）
entries.en: to toy with and make sport of lovers; to tease flirtatiously

entries.zh: 讥诮、阴阳怪气地说；反讽
entries.en: to speak ironically, to say with mockery

entries.zh: 讥刺耍弄、冷嘲热讽地戏弄
entries.en: to taunt and mock ironically

entries.zh: 翻白眼、以眼色讥嘲
entries.en: to mock with eye-gestures; to roll the whites of the eyes at someone
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节声调标记 T99 污損难辨；目白即翻白眼，与西语栏'以目作态嘲弄'相合，惟材料受限记 low。

entries.zh: 吐舌、伸舌头作怪相
entries.en: to put out the tongue (in mockery)
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节声调标记 T99 污損难辨；舌吐即吐舌，与西语栏'sacando la lengua'相合，记 low。

entries.zh: 侮弄、欺弄；嘲弄者（burlón）
entries.en: to insult and make game of; (n.) a mocker, scoffer
entries.notes: M 栏末混入西语 Bufar、R 栏多出 cūn 一音节，属抄写杂入，不碍 侮弄 本义。

entries.zh: 滚闹作耍、翻滚嬉谑（合滚，释义存疑）
entries.en: to romp and tumble in mocking play; sense uncertain
entries.notes: '合'字音栏读 cog 与字形常音不合（或为'咯/谷'类字），滚闹义系就 M/R 与 L 推断，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 清谈闲话、谑浪之词（以言相戏）
entries.en: idle jesting talk; bantering, mocking words

entries.zh: 哄闹戏耍、劝酒相谑一类义（'當酒'词形存疑）
entries.en: uncertain: prob. playful mocking or coaxing (lit. 'serve as wine', reading doubtful)
entries.notes: 汉字栏'當酒'与音栏不合：M 栏三音节（zoà 之音近前条'耍'）、R 栏仅两音节，词形与释义均无法定夺。

entries.zh: 斗嘴、打嘴鼓（以口舌相谑）
entries.en: to banter, spar with words; to mock verbally
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节声调标记 T99 污損难辨；打口鼓即打嘴鼓，与西语栏'Burlarse de palabra'相合，记 low。

entries.zh: 侮弄尊长、冒犯长辈
entries.en: to mock and insult one's elders
